summary: Iteration 4 verified end-to-end: OTP login (dev_otp on screen; verify sets cookie; wrong/expired 401; unknown 404); Register+phone stores phone and OTP-by-phone works. Business Profile PUT/GET saves currency/country; POST /profile/extract (Groq+live fetch) returns company_name/description/industry/suggested_currency for stripe.com; portal(client) users get 403 on /profile/extract. Budget Planner /budget/plan returns SEO-led plan (seo_share_pct>=45), allocations include amount computed server-side = pct%*total, ramp[], expected_total_leads, currency echoes profile (INR). /flow/status returns 9 steps (profile/strategy/content/budget/campaigns/leads/score/convert/report) with done booleans + counts + autopilot flag; toggling PUT /profile {autopilot:true} flips it. Autopilot Proposals: POST /proposals/generate creates ~3 Pending proposals (real Groq — got 7 across two runs), each with data{name,channel,suggested_budget,ad_copy}; approve creates real campaign visible in /campaigns and marks Approved; reject marks Rejected. SECURITY FIX validated: portal user of client A cannot see or mutate any of client B's records — /leads and /campaigns lists exclude them, and all ID-addressed mutations return 403/404: POST /leads/{B}/score, PATCH /leads/{B}/stage, DELETE /leads/{B}, POST /sales/assist {B_lead}, PATCH /campaigns/{B}/metrics, PATCH /campaigns/{B}/toggle, DELETE /campaigns/{B}. Owner-only routes (/clients, /connections GET, /proposals/generate) return 403 for client role. Verified after the block that B's records remain intact (status=Active, impressions=100). All 41 pytest tests pass in ~19s (adds 10 new iter-4 tests covering OTP, profile+extract+authz, budget, flow, proposals lifecycle, security isolation). Frontend E2E (real browser, admin@marketing.ai): method-otp tab -> otp-identifier + request-otp-btn -> dev-otp banner (6-digit) -> otp-code + verify-otp-btn logs into dashboard, cookie set. Sidebar shows sidebar-nav-flow/approvals/budget/settings. Settings settings-tab-profile with profile-website + extract-profile-btn present, profile-currency + profile-country selectors switch to INR/India, save-profile-btn saves. Budget Planner: budget-total accepts 1000000, generate-budget-btn renders allocation cards showing '₹1,000 / ₹1,500 / …' (Intl INR formatting confirmed via '₹' in DOM). Flow page renders 9 flow-step-* items. Approvals page: 7 proposal-* cards after generation, approve-<id> click succeeds and card status transitions, autopilot-toggle flips (visible 'Daily autopilot ON' pill). Screenshot captured.

issues: Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on initial mount — non-blocking, cosmetic.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py _get_scoped raises 404 when doc.user_id != owner (e.g. same-owner cross-client), then 403 when client_id mismatch. Result: for portal users, mutations on other clients' leads/campaigns owned by the SAME agency owner return 403 (correct); mutations on leads/campaigns of a DIFFERENT owner return 404. Both are 'block' — good. But 400 on ObjectId parse errors is still raised in _get_scoped (line 120) — carried from iter-1, non-blocking.

auth.py otp_request always returns dev_otp when channel=='screen'. This is by design (dummy path) but should be gated by an env flag (e.g. OTP_DEV_MODE=true) before production so the code isn't ever leaked in a real deploy.

auth.py otp_request lookups by phone use raw data.identifier (not lowercased). That's correct for phones, but if the user registered phone with '+1 555…' and enters '+1555…' or vice-versa, no match. Consider normalising phone (strip spaces/hyphens) before insert/lookup.

server.py budget_plan: server recomputes amount from pct, which is correct. But if AI returns pct that doesn't sum to 100 (drift), the total spend != total_budget — no reconciliation. Consider normalising pct to sum=100 before amount calc.
server.py extract_profile: swallows all errors from intel.fetch_site_text as 502; the actual reason (DNS/timeout/blocked) is lost. Log it server-side.
server.py _autopilot_loop (line 63) — runs in background; tested manual generate path here. Ensure the loop has a hard sleep so it doesn't spin generate on empty DB.
seed_admin only updates password if changed; role is never re-forced to 'admin' if it drifts. Minor edge case.
Frontend Login.jsx displays dev_otp in a yellow banner — again gate this by an env flag (REACT_APP_OTP_DEV_UI) once real SMS is live to avoid a UX regression.
test_credentials: admin@marketing.ai / admin123. Portal user created per-run e.g. sec_portal_<ts>@test.com / portal123. dev_otp is returned in POST /api/auth/otp/request body when channel='screen'.
seed_data_creation: Test creates TEST_SecA/SecB_<ts> clients, TEST_BLead/BCamp, TEST_NexusCo profile (currency=INR after run — main agent may want to revert to USD for demo). Cleanup done in finally blocks. Real email 'AIMarketing iteration 3 test' regression still sends to ekodecrux@gmail.com.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 41/41 pytest pass in ~19s. Iteration 4 introduced: OTP endpoints (/api/auth/otp/request|verify), /api/profile GET/PUT + /api/profile/extract (owner-only), /api/budget/plan + /api/budget/plans, /api/flow/status, /api/proposals/generate|list|approve|reject with _require_owner + _get_scoped. Security helper _get_scoped(collection, doc_id, user) is now used on all mutation endpoints for leads/campaigns/sales-assist/sales-send-email/proposals — this closes the iter-3 authz gap. If you need to test OTP without spamming SMS, always use identifier=email (channel='screen', dev_otp returned). Frontend testids: method-password, method-otp, otp-identifier, request-otp-btn, dev-otp, otp-code, verify-otp-btn, sidebar-nav-{flow,approvals,budget,settings}, flow-step-<key>, generate-proposals-btn, autopilot-toggle, proposal-<id>, approve-<id>, reject-<id>, budget-total, budget-period, budget-goal, generate-budget-btn, settings-tab-profile, profile-website, profile-currency, profile-country, extract-profile-btn, save-profile-btn. Profile was set to INR/India during test — reset to USD/United States if pristine demo needed.
rca of the issue: No blocking bugs found this iteration. The critical security-isolation fix (main deliverable) is enforced correctly by _get_scoped: (a) doc.user_id != owner -> 404; (b) role=='client' && doc.client_id != user.client_id -> 403. Verified via a real portal user of client-A attempting all 7 known mutation vectors against client-B's lead and campaign — every attempt was blocked (403/404) and B's records remained intact (impressions/status unchanged) after the run.
